_lisez_moi: Text of the /espace/demarrer/ page (set by the Worker, src/routes/pages.js). Same keys as src/contenu/fr/demarrer.json.

comptes.saisir_titre: Enter the key figures from your accounts
comptes.saisir_aide: About ten amounts, copied from your tax return or annual accounts. That’s what turns the first value into one you can defend.
comptes.lecture_indisponible: Automatic tax-return reading is not available right now.
comptes.deposer_aide: That’s what turns the first value into one you can defend. We read the figures; you just confirm them.
comptes.liasse_pdf: Tax return (liasse fiscale) as a PDF
comptes.formulaires: Forms 2033 or 2050 to 2059, 10 MB max. It usually covers two fiscal years.
comptes.saisir_main: Enter the key figures by hand

saisie.repris_inpi: Taken from the public accounts (French national business registry): check it against your accounts.
saisie.il_manque: Missing: {liste}. Enter 0 if the item doesn’t exist.
saisie.reprendre_ebe: Use EBITDA from the public accounts
saisie.detailler: I’d rather break down my expenses
saisie.ecran1: Screen 1 of 2: what the company earns. Copy from your annual accounts; enter 0 if an item doesn’t exist.
saisie.suivant_bilan: Next: what it owns and owes
saisie.ecran2: Screen 2 of 2: what the company owns and owes, at the {annee} year-end. Enter 0 if an item doesn’t exist.

chiffres.aide: Compare with your tax return. Our automatic checks flag what needs your attention; the rest is confirmed in one click.

clients.depuis_aria: Customer {n}: number of years of relationship

erreurs.part_illisible: A share or a number of years can’t be read.
erreurs.part_bornes: Each share must be between 0 and 100%.
erreurs.parts_total: The five shares add up to more than 100% of revenue.

site.a_t_elle: Does your company have a website?
site.aide: We pick up your business description and logo from it for the memorandum while you answer the next questions. You will approve each item.
site.indiquez: Enter the website address, or choose “We don’t have a website”.
site.retenu_titre: What we picked up from your website
site.retenu_aide: {n} facts, grouped by theme. Remove what’s wrong or outdated: only what remains will be used.
site.aucun_fait: We found nothing on this website that the memorandum can use. That's fine: your answers are enough.
site.usage: We pick up your business, your logo and your photos during the next two questions. You’ll confirm each item.
site.conflit_aide: Your website and the registries don’t say the same thing. This fact isn’t used until you decide.
site.les_deux_aide: For example: an older family business, with the current company founded on the registry date.
site.usage_faits: These facts feed the memorandum’s history, business, team and customers, presented as statements by the company.

recap.aide: Check them at a glance. Untick anything inaccurate: you’ll correct it right after, with the few remaining questions.
recap.une_par_une: Answer one question at a time

question.preparee_suite: · {source}. Check it, correct it if needed, then approve.
question.il_manque: {liste} is missing: it’s required to draft the memorandum.
question.choix_max_atteint: {n} of {max}: untick one to change your choice.
question.preparee_court: Answers prepared by Passation, {source}: check them before continuing.

redaction.marche: Web market research (two minutes at most)
redaction.aide: One to two minutes. If you leave this page, drafting resumes when you come back, without redoing what’s finished.
redaction.manque_titre: An answer is missing to draft the memorandum
redaction.manque_aide: The valuation, datapack and teaser are ready. Answer below: drafting of the memorandum will resume right away.
redaction.conserve: What’s finished is kept: only these drafts will be restarted.
redaction.teaser_anonymat: The teaser didn’t pass the anonymity check: rework it from its page (an answer probably contains a name or a brand).

pret.affiner: To fine-tune (discounts and premiums, EBITDA used):
pret.photos: . To add photos to the memorandum:

memo_aide.zero: It’s the document the buyer will read in full: review it chapter by chapter. Add a photo to illustrate it.
memo_aide.one: With your photo. It’s the document the buyer will read in full: review it chapter by chapter.
memo_aide.other: With your {photos} photos. It’s the document the buyer will read in full: review it chapter by chapter.

montants.raison_neutre: the same amount, so no adjustment

dates.date_n: Date of event {n}: year, month/year or full date

photos.aide: An illustrated memorandum reads better. Here’s what we found on your website.
photos.cochez_droits: First tick the box: these photos belong to the company, or you have the right to use them.
photos.logo_aide: It will appear on the memorandum’s cover and in the footer.
photos.logo_aucun_aide: No logo selected: the memorandum will show only its title.

echecs.one: One item couldn’t be retrieved from your website: you can upload it yourself.
echecs.other: {n} items couldn’t be retrieved from your website: you can upload them yourself.

photos.usage: {max} at most. They are placed by category: cover, business, past work, team.
photos.aucune: We didn’t find a usable photo on your website (icons, banners and small images are left out).
photos.droits: These photos belong to the company, or I have the right to use them.
photos.formats: (PNG, JPEG or WebP, 3 MB at most)
photos.ou_va: The logo goes on the cover and in the footer; each photo goes where its category fits, never twice.
photos.aide_jugement: Claude looks at each photo you add: what it shows, its quality and where to place it. Nothing is applied without you.
photos.cliquez_ajouter: Photos found on your website: click to add
photos.aide_site: Click the photos of your website to keep, or upload your own: workshop, premises, projects, team.
photos.aide_sans_site: Upload your photos: workshop, premises, projects, team. Twelve at most; two or three good photos are enough.

accueil.titre: Let’s start the detailed valuation of your company
accueil.chapo: First, what your company is worth and why; then the documents a buyer asks for: the Excel datapack, the anonymous teaser and the memorandum.
accueil.chiffres: Your accounts for the last three fiscal years (tax return as a PDF or a few amounts), your adjustments and your debt: you see the value of your shares, line by line.
accueil.chiffres_publics: Your accounts for the last three fiscal years (tax return as a PDF or a few amounts), your adjustments and your debt. We already have the published accounts for {annees}.
accueil.reponses: Once your figures are approved: {n} questions about your company, mostly tick boxes, then your photos and your team.
accueil.redaction: Passation calculates and writes in a few minutes. You review everything before sending.
accueil.reprise: You can stop at any time: everything is saved.

equipe.aide: One to four people, including you. The memorandum, shared only after a confidentiality agreement, will present them on one page. The teaser never names anyone or describes their background.
equipe.precision_exemple: Short detail, for example “workshop manager, 8 years”
equipe.consentement: This person agreed to have their photo in the memorandum.
equipe.consentement_aide: Without this box, the photo is not saved: the page shows initials instead.
equipe.cochez_consentement: First tick the box confirming this person agreed to have their photo in the memorandum.
equipe.photo_enregistree: Photo saved, with the person's consent.
equipe.accord_enregistre: Photo published with the person's consent.
equipe.rgpd: Names, backgrounds and photos are used only in the memorandum. They are deleted with your file.
equipe.ou_va: These answers feed the “Management team” page of the memorandum: Claude writes each background from your answers only.

exercices.aide: A buyer reasons over three years: the EBITDA used is the average of the fiscal years you confirm. {dernier} is confirmed; add the two before it.
exercices.liasse: A tax return often covers two fiscal years:
exercices.perte: The EBITDA used will rest on {annees} only. An exceptional year, good or bad, will then weigh entirely on the range, and a buyer will find it less solid.

retraitements.aide: A buyer reasons on normal earnings: your pay at market rate, a market rent, without events that won’t happen again. Each answer changes the value: nothing is filled in for you.
retraitements.total_inconnu: The EBITDA of your latest fiscal year is not known yet: complete your figures to see the effect of the adjustments.
retraitements.effet_attente: Effect on EBITDA: enter both amounts.
retraitements.dirigeant_aide: The adjustment that weighs most: the gap between what you cost and what a salaried manager would cost is added to EBITDA (or removed).
retraitements.credit_bail_aide: It does not change EBITDA: its payments stay in it. The remaining principal is counted at the next step, with your debts. This convention may undervalue a company that finances its equipment through leasing: discuss it with your advisor.
retraitements.exc_vide: Enter at least one one-off amount, or answer “No”.
retraitements.usage: These adjustments feed the valuation bridge, the datapack (“Adjustments” tab) and the financial chapter of the memorandum.

dette.titre: Net debt and scope of the sale
dette.aide: The value of the company becomes the value of your shares once cash is added and debts are removed. The buyer also wants to know what they are buying.
dette.bilan_vide: Your balance sheet shows neither cash nor borrowings.
dette.autres_titre: What the balance sheet does not detail
dette.autres_aide: Leave empty what does not apply to you.
dette.perimetre_aide: Who is the buyer buying the shares from, and what does the sale include?
dette.usage: These answers feed the bridge to the value of the shares, the legal structure chart and the “Transaction” chapter of the memorandum.

valeur.aide: The full calculation, as a banker reads it. Check each line: these are the figures the memorandum and the datapack will use.
valeur.impossible: The value cannot be calculated yet.
valeur.pont_titre: From EBITDA to the value of your shares
valeur.source_multiples: EBITDA multiples of your industry: cross-check of public references on SME transactions, as of {mois}. Amounts in thousands of euros; in brackets, what is deducted.
valeur.detail: See the detail of the calculation (sensitivities, discounts and premiums)
valeur.validee_le: Figures approved on {date}. You can still change them.
valeur.usage: Once you approve, the memorandum starts: your company, your photos, your team, then the drafting.
